    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（六）使用离线大模型对文本生成摘要</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span>上一篇文章末尾使用了在线大模型压缩文本生成摘要，但该方式会消耗Token，不便初学者长期使用，更好的办法是采用离线大模型来生成文本摘要。
<h1>一、离线大模型的种类</h1>
<p>国内常用的离线大模型有阿里Qwen、智谱GLM、深度求索DeepSeek、百度文心等等，以千问的文本大模型为例，又有Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat和Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat两种。<br>
Qwen1.5是一系列不同大小的解码器语言模型，包括基础语言模型及其对齐的聊天模型。它基于Transformer架构，使用SwiGLU激活函数、注意力QKV偏置、组查询注意力、滑动窗口注意力与全注意力混合等技术。此外，Qwen1.5还提供了改进后适应多种自然语言和代码的分词器。</p>
<p>其中Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat的模型页面为 https://modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat ，名称中的1.8B指的是18亿参数（1.8 Billion），模型文件大小为3.69GB。<br>
Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat的模型页面为 https://modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat ，名称中的0.5B指的是5亿参数（0.5 Billion），模型文件大小为1.25GB。</p>
<p>对于大模型来说，参数的数量就是模型的“脑子大小”，越多越好。</p>
<p>参数越大（比如1.8B），大模型越聪明、懂的多、逻辑好、写文章 / 推理更强；缺点是占内存 / 硬盘更大、对电脑配置要求更高、跑得慢。<br>
参数越小（比如0.5B），大模型越傻瓜，复杂推理、写长文不行，只能日常聊天、简单问答；优点是占用空间小、手机 / 低配电脑都能离线跑、速度飞快。</p>
<p>本教程涉及到的代码使用场合，推荐使用Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat，因为0.5B的大模型往往给不出令人满意的回答。</p>
<h1>二、下载离线大模型</h1>
<p>在下载离线大模型前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20modelscope%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install modelscope</code></pre>
</div>
<p>接着命令行通过cd命令进入Python工程的所在目录，再执行下面的模型下载命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22modelscope%20download%20--model%20Qwen%2FQwen1.5-1.8B-Chat%20--local_dir%20qwen1.5-1.8b-chat%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">modelscope download --model Qwen/Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat --local_dir qwen1.5-1.8b-chat</code></pre>
</div>
<p>上面下载命令的“--model”参数表示离线大模型为“Qwen/Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat”，而“--local_dir”参数表示离线大模型的本地保存目录。</p>
<p>注意Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat的总大小为3.69GB，下载过程较耗时，请耐心等待。下载完毕，即可在Python工程的目录下方找到qwen1.5-1.8b-chat文件夹，里面保存的便是Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat的具体模型文件。</p>
<h1>三、使用离线大模型输出摘要</h1>
<p>接下来演示如何使用Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat对一段文本生成摘要。在编写Python代码前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">

</div>
<p>然后编写下面的Python摘要测试代码：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20transformers%20import%20AutoTokenizer%2C%20AutoModelForCausalLM%5Cn%5Cnmodel_path%20%3D%20%5C%22.%2Fqwen1.5-1.8b-chat%5C%22%20%23%20%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E7%9A%84%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E7%9B%AE%E5%BD%95%5Cn%5Cndef%20local_model_summary(text%3A%20str%2C%20max_new_tokens%3D256)%20-%3E%20str%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%20Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat%20%E5%81%9A%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E3%80%90%E6%97%A0%E9%9C%80%E8%81%94%E7%BD%91%E3%80%81%E6%97%A0%E9%9C%80%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E3%80%81%E7%BA%AF%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E3%80%91%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E5%88%86%E8%AF%8D%E5%99%A8%20%2B%20%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%88%E5%AE%8C%E5%85%A8%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%EF%BC%89%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20tokenizer%20%3D%20AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model_path%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20trust_remote_code%3DTrue%20%C2%A0%23%20Qwen%20%E5%BF%85%E9%A1%BB%E5%8A%A0%E8%BF%99%E4%B8%AA%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model%20%3D%20AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model_path%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20trust_remote_code%3DTrue%2C%20%C2%A0%23%20Qwen%20%E5%BF%85%E9%A1%BB%E5%8A%A0%E8%BF%99%E4%B8%AA%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20dtype%3D%5C%22auto%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20device_map%3D%5C%22auto%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20).eval()%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E6%9E%84%E9%80%A0%20Qwen1.5%20%E5%AE%98%E6%96%B9%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%E6%A0%BC%E5%BC%8F%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20messages%20%3D%20%5B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7B%5C%22role%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22system%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22content%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22%E8%AF%B7%E5%AF%B9%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E7%9A%84%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%E5%81%9A%E7%B2%BE%E7%AE%80%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%8C%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E5%8E%8B%E7%BC%A9%E5%9C%A850%E5%AD%97%E4%BB%A5%E5%86%85%5C%22%7D%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7B%5C%22role%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22user%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22content%5C%22%3A%20text%7D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5D%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E5%AE%98%E6%96%B9%E6%A8%A1%E6%9D%BF%E6%9E%84%E9%80%A0%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20text_input%20%3D%20tokenizer.apply_chat_template(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20messages%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20tokenize%3DFalse%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20add_generation_prompt%3DTrue%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20)%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20inputs%20%3D%20tokenizer(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5Btext_input%5D%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return_tensors%3D%5C%22pt%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20truncation%3DTrue%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20).to(model.device)%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20outputs%20%3D%20model.generate(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20**inputs%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20max_new_tokens%3Dmax_new_tokens%2C%20%23%20%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%E6%9C%80%E5%A4%9A%E5%8D%A0%E7%94%A8%E5%A4%9A%E5%B0%91Token%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20temperature%3D0.3%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20top_p%3D0.7%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20do_sample%3DTrue%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20pad_token_id%3Dtokenizer.eos_token_id%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20)%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E6%8F%90%E5%8F%96%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BB%93%E6%9E%9C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20response%20%3D%20outputs%5B0%5D%5Blen(inputs%5B%5C%22input_ids%5C%22%5D%5B0%5D)%3A%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20summary%20%3D%20tokenizer.decode(response%2C%20skip_special_tokens%3DTrue)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20summary.strip()%5Cn%5Cnif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22__main__%5C%22%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20content%20%3D%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E6%98%AF%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E6%8E%A8%E5%87%BA%E7%9A%84%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%EF%BC%8C%E6%8F%90%E4%BE%9B%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E3%80%81%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E3%80%81%E8%AF%84%E6%B5%8B%E3%80%81%E7%B2%BE%E8%B0%83%E7%AD%89%E5%85%A8%E6%96%B9%E4%BD%8D%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E4%B8%8E%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E5%A4%9A%E7%A7%8D%E4%B8%BB%E6%B5%81%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%85%B7%E6%9C%89%E7%A8%B3%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%AF%E9%9D%A0%E3%80%81%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E4%BA%92%E4%BF%A1%E7%9A%84%E7%89%B9%E7%82%B9%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E4%BC%81%E4%B8%9A%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E9%80%9A%E8%BF%87%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E7%9A%84AI%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%8C%E9%99%8D%E4%BD%8E%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%88%90%E6%9C%AC%E4%B8%8E%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%E9%97%A8%E6%A7%9B%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%E6%AD%A3%E5%9C%A8%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E3%80%90%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E3%80%91%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81...%5C%5Cn%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20result%20%3D%20local_model_summary(content%2C%20max_new_tokens%3D28)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%E3%80%90%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BB%93%E6%9E%9C%E3%80%91%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22-%5C%22%2C%20result)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM

model_path = "./qwen1.5-1.8b-chat" # 离线大模型的本地保存目录

def local_model_summary(text: str, max_new_tokens=256) -&gt; str:
&nbsp; &nbsp; """
&nbsp; &nbsp; 加载本地离线模型 Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat 做摘要
&nbsp; &nbsp; 【无需联网、无需下载、纯本地运行】
&nbsp; &nbsp; """

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 加载本地分词器 + 本地模型（完全离线）
&nbsp; &nbsp; tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; model_path,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; trust_remote_code=True &nbsp;# Qwen 必须加这个
&nbsp; &nbsp; )
&nbsp; &nbsp; model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; model_path,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; trust_remote_code=True, &nbsp;# Qwen 必须加这个
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; dtype="auto",
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; device_map="auto"
&nbsp; &nbsp; ).eval()

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 构造 Qwen1.5 官方对话格式
&nbsp; &nbsp; messages = [
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {"role": "system", "content": "请对用户输入的内容做精简摘要，摘要文字压缩在50字以内"},
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {"role": "user", "content": text}
&nbsp; &nbsp; ]

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 官方模板构造
&nbsp; &nbsp; text_input = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; messages,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; tokenize=False,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; add_generation_prompt=True
&nbsp; &nbsp; )

&nbsp; &nbsp; inputs = tokenizer(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [text_input],
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return_tensors="pt",
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; truncation=True
&nbsp; &nbsp; ).to(model.device)

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 离线生成摘要
&nbsp; &nbsp; outputs = model.generate(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; **inputs,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, # 返回文本最多占用多少Token
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; temperature=0.3,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; top_p=0.7,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; do_sample=True,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; pad_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id
&nbsp; &nbsp; )

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 提取摘要结果
&nbsp; &nbsp; response = outputs[0][len(inputs["input_ids"][0]):]
&nbsp; &nbsp; summary = tokenizer.decode(response, skip_special_tokens=True)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return summary.strip()

if __name__ == "__main__":
&nbsp; &nbsp; content = """
&nbsp; &nbsp; 火山方舟是火山引擎推出的大模型平台，提供模型训练、推理、评测、精调等全方位功能与服务。
&nbsp; &nbsp; 平台支持多种主流大模型接入，具有稳定可靠、安全互信的特点。
&nbsp; &nbsp; 企业可以通过火山方舟快速构建自己的AI应用，降低开发成本与技术门槛。
&nbsp; &nbsp; """

&nbsp; &nbsp; print("正在使用【本地离线模型】生成摘要...\n")
&nbsp; &nbsp; result = local_model_summary(content, max_new_tokens=28)
&nbsp; &nbsp; print("【离线摘要结果】")
&nbsp; &nbsp; print("-", result)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E3%80%90%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BB%93%E6%9E%9C%E3%80%91%5Cn-%20%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E6%8E%A8%E5%87%BA%E7%81%AB%E7%A5%9E%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%EF%BC%8C%E9%9B%86%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E3%80%81%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E3%80%81%E8%AF%84%E6%B5%8B%E3%80%81%E7%B2%BE%E8%B0%83%E4%BA%8E%E4%B8%80%E4%BD%93%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%BA%E4%BC%81%E4%B8%9A%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BAAI%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%E8%8A%82%E7%9C%81%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%88%90%E6%9C%AC%E5%92%8C%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">【离线摘要结果】
- 火山引擎推出火神引擎平台，集模型训练、推理、评测、精调于一体，为企业构建AI应用节省开发成本和技术</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见离线大模型Qwen1.5-1.8B-Chat输出了原始文本经过压缩后的摘要文字，还支持设置返回内容的Token长度（max_new_tokens），并且不消耗Token，适合初学者练习AI应用开发。</p>
<p>本系列的AI应用开发文章目录为《<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="0" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">15天学会AI应用开发全目录（零基础小白，零Token消耗）》。</span></p>
